questions.text: The plan could not meet the indoor temperature requirement. Should I keep the house at 22°C during the away period?

explanation: I have planned the away mode from 2016-12-19 07:00 to 2016-12-23 18:00 and set the comfort level to 22°C. However, the plan could not meet the indoor temperature requirement.

requirements_check.requirement: indoor temperature in the requested bands
